The '''Birch Park''' is a sub-location of [[The Park]].

{{ZoneText|Talk to Charlie.|Chop down Birch logs.}}

== Features ==
There are various mechanics active in the '''Birch Park''', and affect some aspects of gameplay.

=== Charlie ===
{{Main|Charlie}}
{{NPCSprite|Charlie}} is an [[NPC]] located right in front of the [[Launch Pad]] to the '''Birch Park''', when the player arrives from the {{Zone|Forest}}. They are part of the "Into the Woods" [[Quests|Quest]], and require the player to chop down {{Item|Birch Log|amount=64}}s. The player will be rewarded for completing the quest with {{Item|Charlie's Trousers}}, a {{Item|Travel Scroll to The Park}}, {{Coins|1,000}}, {{Skill XP|+250 Foraging}}, and access to the {{Zone|Spruce Woods}}.

=== Rain ===
{{See also|Vanessa}}
{{NPCSprite|Vanessa}} can be paid {{C|5,000}} to make the it rain in the '''Birch Park''' for {{Green|60s}}, with the limit of {{Green|30m}}.

While raining, players gain {{Stat|fs|+25}}. Additionally, every {{Green|11}} seconds there's a {{Chance|66.6%|2|3|rolls}} chance to spawn {{Green|1-2}} {{MobSprite|Squid}}s in water if there's less than {{Green|5}} {{MobSprite|Squid}}s alive.

=== Flower Pot ===
In what looks to be a ruined building, there is a [[Flower Pot]] with a [[mcw:Torchflower|Torchflower]] that, when clicked, emits particles and makes a noise. This noise increases in pitch the more one holds left or right-click. Clicking without a flower emits a different sound and particles. 

The only known use for this flower pot is to obtain the {{ach|Empty Flower Pot?|ach=true}}, which is obtained when one hold a left or right-click on it with any [[Flowers|flower]] for over {{Green|5}} minutes until the pitch of the sound hits its peak.
